name: Chevill
description: An ally who helps Vivien Reid set a trap for Lukka.

description_citations.text: "Lukka". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vivien and Chevill's hunters prepare an ambush with buried explosives in a canyon, expecting Lukka.
timeline.quote: she and Chevill were the only thing standing between those people and their doom.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: A vantasaur flees the canyon, is dragged back and consumed by something unseen.
timeline.quote: before all thirty tons were dragged violently backward out of sight

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Phyrexian Lukka emerges from the canyon, a titan of absorbed flesh with Lukka embedded at its center.
timeline.quote: At its center protruded—not a man, anymore, not quite, but Lukka.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The titan triggers buried mines and plunges its leg into lava, and Chevill's hunters attack with poisoned arrows and spears.
timeline.quote: They loosed a stinging cloud of arrows, peppering the Lukka-thing's flank

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Chevill refuses to follow, saying they have lost, but Vivien holds him back and fires an arrow into the sky as a signal of failure.
timeline.quote: before twisting her body and shooting it straight into the sky

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Ikoria is targeted in the New Phyrexian Invasion and Vivien arranges its defense with Chevill and Jirina Kudro.
timeline.quote: Vivien took to arranging the defense of Ikoria alongside Chevill and Jirina Kudro .

citation.text: "Ikoria", section "Phyrexian invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Lukka destroys Drannith, leaving survivors who flee toward Lavabrink, and compleats monsters on the way; Vivien and Chevill's trap fails.
timeline.quote: Lukka first destroyed Drannith , leaving a convoy of survivors that fled for Lavabrink .

citation.text: "Lukka", section "March of the Machine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jirina survives the sacking of Drannith and leads survivors to Lavabrink with Vivien and Chevill.
timeline.quote: Jirina, survived Lukka's sacking of Drannith, leading the survivors to Lavabrink

citation.text: "Jirina Kudro", section "Invasion of New Phyrexia". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citation.work: Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths: card flavor text
citation.text: Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths: card flavor text (Ikoria: Lair of Behemoths, 2020), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

pages_say.description: Ikoria's most accomplished monster hunter, a boastful exterminator who helps ambush Lukka.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ikoria: Survival of the Fittest" by Roy Graham. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Mar 2023.

pages_say.description: A defender who helped arrange Ikoria's defense with Vivien and Jirina.

citation.text: "Ikoria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Assisted Jirina on the way to Lavabrink.

citation.text: "Jirina Kudro". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
